export_policy.scale64: one E4M3 source with all BN auxiliary state per selected checkpoint; lower exports derived only from saved/reloaded source codes and source scale code+6; separate FP32 resume checkpoint
export_policy.scale32: one E4M3 source with all BN auxiliary state per selected checkpoint; lower exports derived only from saved/reloaded source codes and source scale code+5; separate FP32 resume checkpoint

mantissa_mapping.scale64: derived E2M3 uint8 codes >> 2; unchanged E2M3 scale equals original E4M3 scale times64
mantissa_mapping.scale32: derived E2M3 uint8 codes >> 2; unchanged E2M3 scale equals original E4M3 scale times32

mx_scale_policy.scale64: encode current E4M3 source scale floor(log2(amax))-8; clip[-127,127], zero block exponent0; both lower scale codes equal source code+6; integer promoted before addition; overflow above254 rejected without clipping/wrap, including zero blocks; source scales can change after optimizer steps
mx_scale_policy.scale32: encode current E4M3 source scale floor(log2(amax))-8; clip[-127,127], zero block exponent0; both lower scale codes equal source code+5; integer promoted before addition; overflow above254 rejected without clipping/wrap, including zero blocks; source scales can change after optimizer steps

purpose.scale64: 100 complete train-only epochs: route B, E4M3 source, naive exponent truncation plus fixed scale64 to E2M3, then mantissa truncation to E2M1
purpose.scale32: five complete train-only epochs: fixed scale32 route, E4M3 source, naive exponent truncation plus fixed scale32 to E2M3, then mantissa truncation to E2M1

reporting_policy.scale64: all three modes from same selected E4M3-best checkpoint and epoch100; incomplete runs also retain last completed epoch
reporting_policy.scale32: all three modes from same selected E4M3-best checkpoint; also all at last pilot epoch

ste_policy.scale64: identity wrt G(W) for E4M3 and complete scale64 E4-to-E2 code path; no extra factor64 in backward; retain original G(W) derivatives; no gradient through codes or scales
ste_policy.scale32: identity wrt G(W) for E4M3 and complete scale32 E4-to-E2 code path; no extra factor32 in backward; retain original G(W) derivatives; no gradient through codes or scales

export_audit_scope: recorded CUDA exact-weight validation and CSV/metadata consistency; PT exports/checkpoints are not attached, no independent tensor replay performed
